description: This file contains the PHP class 'Translation' in the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Design'. The class manages CRUD operations related to design translations in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, editing, and saving translation entries, as well as generating URLs and handling user permissions.
